title: Heterogeneous Path Validator and Rollback Playbook for Quant Safety
creator: Priya Shah
description: Implement a runtime component (Path Validator) and an operational rollback playbook that ensures safe selection and activation of mixed-precision execution paths (FP16/FP8/INT8). This ticket covers a lightweight in-band validation step, shadow-run calibration comparison, SLO-aligned gating, and runbook content to revert on observed regression. The goal is to allow aggressive quant profile rollouts while limiting customer-facing accuracy regressions and enabling fast remediation.
acceptance_criteria: Path Validator implements per-request lightweight fidelity checks without adding >2ms median p95 latency for FP16 baseline routes.
Shadow validation can compare outputs from candidate quant path vs FP16 baseline across 1000 sample prompts and produce accuracy delta metrics on /api/telemetry/quant/validation.
Automated gating prevents >5% of requests from switching to a new quant path if sample-based top-1/EM deltas exceed configured thresholds.
Rollback playbook documented in Confluence and tested in staging; includes an automated operator command to revert routing table within 30s.
End-to-end integration tests exist in CI that assert safe-swap logic, metric instrumentation, and fallback behavior for hardware failures.
Telemetry dashboards (Datadog) created with alerts for accuracy-regression, token-variance, and customer-error-rate spikes.
Security review completed and KMS access for calibration payloads validated.
implementation_notes: Add a new runtime module 'path_validator' that executes shadow runs for a configurable fraction (default 1%) and aggregates token-level logprobs and normalized similarity metrics.
Leverage existing KV cache to do prefix-only shadow inference to reduce compute cost when comparing generative outputs.

Design gating policy: sample-based evaluation (N=1000) + continuous streaming checks (sliding window 10k requests) with asymmetric thresholds: 0.6% for language perplexity change, 1.5% for task-specific accuracy drop.
Expose a calibration endpoint for offline profiling: /internal/quant/calibrate with RBAC and audit logging; store profiles in model-metadata bucket with version tags.
Implement canary rollout integration with Console: add toggle to route X% traffic to quant path with automatic shadow validation and abort on threshold breach.
Fail-open semantics: if validator service is unavailable, default to conservative execution path (FP16) and emit cross-service incident metric.
CI tests: include synthetic prompt set from 'evals/quant-safety/bench-a' and shadow-compare unit tests in runtime-integration-suite.
Cost control: ensure shadow runs are throttled and sampled by request size; add budget meter for extra GPU time consumed by validation.
